selected_design.config_change: Per-cell _MG_RegimeFile basename only; _MG_InCommon=false and all other trading/risk defaults unchanged. Qualification behavior is compile-flag/tester-only.
selected_design.runtime_sha256_prospective: Native CryptEncode over raw bytes read once; compare compiled expected digest before parsing same buffer.

transfer_contract.compile_semantics: Declare eleven constant basenames in the main MQ5. Existence at compile time enables dependency recognition; CSV content is transferred later, not embedded in EX5. One prospective Boss15 EX5 declares all eleven dependencies.
transfer_contract.runtime_selection: The separately frozen cell set chooses _MG_RegimeFile; _MG_InCommon remains false. The host checks the cell set/fingerprint before launch and rejects a different valid basename too.
transfer_contract.host_precompile: Verify every compiler-terminal MQL5/Files dependency against the golden SHA256 map. Reuse only byte-identical files already owned by the contract; conflicting/unowned paths block, never overwrite them.
transfer_contract.host_prelaunch: Immediately before each diagnostic launch rehash exact terminal dependency paths against the run manifest, freeze timestamped source-path/digest/EX5/set/build receipts, and hold read-sharing-only file handles through handoff. Negative fixtures use an explicit non-trading negative-test manifest, not a production gate bypass.
transfer_contract.runtime_current_capability: No qualified raw-CSV-byte hash adapter exists in current MacroGate. CFG_Sha256Hex for text is NOT an arbitrary raw-file hash. The following adapter is a new prospective requirement, not an implemented guarantee.
transfer_contract.runtime_future_adapter: Under LAB_MG_TESTER_EVIDENCE_QUAL and MQL_TESTER and _MG_SelfGate, require a basename in the compiled golden map. Open FILE_READ|FILE_BIN without FILE_COMMON or write-sharing; check FileSize against the exact mapped size, allocate uchar bytes to that length, FileReadArray once and require the full count. CryptEncode(CRYPT_HASH_SHA256, bytes, empty_key, digest) must return 32 bytes. Compare to the compiled expected digest BEFORE strategy initialization.
transfer_contract.same_buffer_rule: Hash and parse the same immutable uchar buffer; do not close/reopen to parse a mutable file or hash a normalized string. Decode accepted UTF-8 only after the digest matches; preserve the existing parser, state/action, UNKNOWN, offset and row-selection behavior for accepted feeds. Require loader parity tests on all eleven golden feeds.
transfer_contract.expected_identity_binding: The eleven filename/SHA256/size/row/first/last tuples in FEED_RUNTIME_EXPECTATIONS.json become a source-bound allowlist. They are not supplied by an untrusted sidecar next to the file and not inferred from metadata.
transfer_contract.init_failure_rule: For the qualification build only, tester self-gate init returns INIT_FAILED before strategy code on unknown filename, Common mode, missing/open/size/read/hash/parser/metadata failure. With BASE _MG_SelfGate=false no feed is consumed; attempt telemetry is still active. Other builds and non-tester behavior remain unchanged.
transfer_contract.metadata_role: Diagnostic corroboration only; filename, size, rows and endpoints are not exact-byte proof.
transfer_contract.stale_policy: A stale/different-content file must fail the golden digest check; the existing accepted loader freshness/timing semantics are not retuned. Do not substitute a wall-clock freshness guess for content identity.
transfer_contract.live_common_impact: No Common/Files writes, no live feed replacement, no silent _MG_InCommon=true, no manual agent-sandbox injection.

denominator_design.scope: Only the future Boss15 qualification build opts in. Observe both BASE_OFF and guarded arms. No new rejection, retry, normalization, risk logic or return-value change.

units.strategy_intent_total: Calls entering Lab_OpenOrder before its existing quote/SL/heat early returns; not every signal or OnTick predicate. Tag upstream refusals separately. Other execution-call paths need not have a Lab_OpenOrder parent.
units.execution_entry_total: Every call to Exec_Open or Exec_PlacePending, before existing short-circuit news/macro/spread/volume gates. This NEW prospective unit is NOT the historical request-line denominator.
units.submit_total: Every invocation of an existing CTrade opening method after upstream checks, including local-library failures before native send.
units.native_request_total: Every actual forwarded CTrade::OrderSend invocation while an opening-call context is active; do not count closes, modifications or cancellations.
units.accepted_request_total: Native requests whose bool/retcode combination qualifies as accepted; not a trade/fill count.
units.rejected_request_total: Known failed native request results, retaining raw transport bool/retcode/error. This is not a claim of broker rejection or absence of a later fill.
units.entry_fill_total: Distinct observed DEAL_ADD entry/entry-inout deal IDs associated with opening order IDs; partial fills may create multiple events. Never a request denominator.
units.unresolved_request_total: Native results whose classification cannot be certified. They remain separate and invalidate ratio certification.

denominator_design.native_observer: Use the installed CTrade protected virtual OrderSend seam with a qualification-only derived class in Execution.mqh. Forward to CTrade::OrderSend(request,result) exactly once without modifying request/result/return or retry policy. When feature disabled or not MQL_TESTER, call the original behavior without telemetry. Keep SetAsyncMode(false). Vendor Trade.mqh stays unchanged; bind its hash and requalify if it changes.

outcome_categories.MARKET_ACCEPTED_DONE: transport_bool=true, retcode=TRADE_RETCODE_DONE, positive deal/order identity and result_volume equals normalized requested volume within the prospectively frozen SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP tolerance. Otherwise UNRESOLVED_RESULT; later fill-event count is separate.
outcome_categories.MARKET_ACCEPTED_PARTIAL: transport_bool=true, retcode=TRADE_RETCODE_DONE_PARTIAL, positive deal/order identity and 0 < result_volume <= normalized requested volume within the frozen lot-step tolerance. Preserve partial status even if volume rounds to requested volume.
outcome_categories.MARKET_ACCEPTED_PENDING: transport_bool=true, retcode=TRADE_RETCODE_PLACED and positive order ID. Await independently observed transaction/fill evidence.
outcome_categories.PENDING_PLACED: transport_bool=true and retcode=PLACED or DONE with positive order ID. Pending placement is not a fill; later fills are outside the request denominator.
outcome_categories.REQUEST_REJECTED: A documented non-acceptance retcode or a transport failure with no contradictory acceptance evidence. Preserve raw bool, retcode, last_error and IDs; timeout/connection failure does not prove no later fill. Unknown codes or contradictory accepted retcodes with false bool are UNRESOLVED_RESULT.
outcome_categories.UNRESOLVED_RESULT: Unknown/contradictory bool-retcode-ID-volume combination. Mark counters/ratios unavailable rather than silently force SUCCESS or FAILURE.

denominator_design.success_rule: CTrade boolean alone NEVER proves accepted request or execution. Preserve existing EA bool return semantics even when evidence classification is stricter. Record raw result_volume and requested/normalized volume.
denominator_design.fill_observation: A gated passive hook composed into LabCore OnTradeTransaction observes distinct entry deal IDs and links order IDs without mutating orders/history. Do not treat eventual pending fills as new submission attempts. Missing transaction coverage makes fill totals unavailable, never substituted into entry/request totals. Correlate by order/deal IDs, not transaction arrival order; queue unmatched events until mapping is available, deduplicate deal IDs, and leave fill coverage unavailable if completeness cannot be certified. Entry-inout volume remains a separate observed mixed-entry event, not inferred net-new exposure.
completeness: Monotonic gap-free event sequence per captured session and attempt IDs per execution entry
Exactly one EXECUTION_END per execution entry and one SUBMIT_RETURN per submit call
Every NATIVE_SEND_BEGIN has one matching NATIVE_SEND_RESULT; zero-to-many native calls per submit is counted, not assumed
Require exactly one RUN_BEGIN/RUN_END and process/build/config/session binding; ordinary terminal completion is separately checked
Missing footer, duplicate/gapped IDs, mixed sessions, malformed records, unresolved results or counter mismatch => UNAVAILABLE_NOT_CERTIFIED
invariants: all submitted and terminal event IDs reconcile; no count is inferred from final trades
fill totals are independent of request counts

denominator_design.behavior_preservation: Retain original NewsGuard-before-MacroGate short-circuit and all early returns, existing g_exec_open_intents, CTrade settings, lot math and return values. Telemetry is passive and unthrottled in the opted-in tester only; parity tests must detect any changed decision/request/return/observable error state.
denominator_design.classification_order: First reject incomplete/unknown/contradictory field combinations as UNRESOLVED_RESULT, then recognize path-specific acceptance, then known non-acceptance. Freeze enum labels and volume tolerance in the future executable validator before outcomes. No bool-only SUCCESS.
